cd /tmp
echo "=== GET /projects (authenticated, cookie) ==="

head -c 300 /tmp/proj.json; echo
echo "=== POST create project ==="
curl -s -b cj.txt -o /tmp/create.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 \
  -X POST http://localhost:3000/pls/v1/projects \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"Validierungsverfahren","projectTypeId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","entryDate":"2026-10-05","internalProjectNumber":"VAL-001"}'
head -c 800 /tmp/create.json; echo
